tagline: Your guide to reading science like a scientist

criterionDescriptions.title: Does the title describe the finding accurately, without hype?
criterionDescriptions.access: Can anyone read the full study free of charge?
criterionDescriptions.source: Was it published by a trustworthy, independent outlet?
criterionDescriptions.theory: Does it build on earlier research to fill a real gap in knowledge?
criterionDescriptions.methods: Are the design, sample and controls adequate, and are the data open?
criterionDescriptions.conclusion: Do the claims stay within what the data show?
